label: A_tI2_139_a-002
title: Pa ($A_{a}$) Structure
comments:
When $c/a=\sqrt{2/3}\approx 0.861$ the coordination number of this system is 10, as the atoms at the points $(0,0,\pm c)$ are at the same distance from the atom at the origin as the atoms at $(\pm a/2,\pm a/2,\pm c/2)$.  In protactinium $c/a = 0.823$. 
 We take our data from (Zachariasen, 1959), but the ICSD entry is from the later work of (Benedict, 1982). 
 The \href{current_web_home_dir/A_tI2_139_a-001}{indium ($A6$)} and \href{current_web_home_dir/A_tI2_139_a-002}{protactinium ($A_{a}$)} structures have the same AFLOW prototype label, A\_tI2\_139\_a. They are generated by the same symmetry operations with different sets of parameters ({\tt --params}) specified in their corresponding CIF files. 
 The ICSD lists both structures under the high-pressure Sn(tI2) structure type.  We instead follow the {\em Strukturbericht} designation and assign structures with $c/a > 1$ to $A6$ while $A_{a}$ has $c/a < 1$.
